column6: Any weapon, so nothing swings on its own: a brief hard glint on the wielder as the adamantine bites.
The battleaxe swing in forge-fire orange, for the artifact of the dwarven forges.
A siege bolt: the crossbow shot, at siege scale.
The greatsword swing wreathed in black — the soul-drinking blade.
A cannonball fired, with the powder report.
The dagger strike with a green venom sheen on the blade.
Any melee weapon: a cool blue glint as the blade turns to guard.
Any weapon: the blade flares dragon-fire orange on the swing.
The warhammer strike; thrown, the hammer returns.
A bound spell shows as a rune at the wielder, not as a swing.
The longsword swing with the blade alight — the flame tongue.
A gout of fire down a 60-foot line.
The longsword swing in rime-blue — the frost brand.
Any weapon: a bright glint on the swing, the giant-bane bite.
The maul strike, and thunder on the hit.
Any weapon in a paladin's hand: the blade burns holy gold.
The javelin thrown, and a lightning line where it lands.
A keg lobbed and burst into a toxic cloud.
A ball of lightning fired down the range.
The club strike with a thunderous chord struck on the hit.
The mace strike with a radiant burst on the hit.
The mace strike, harder — the smiting mace.
The mace strike; the terror is a fear mark on those who fail, not on the swing.
A stone lobbed in a high arc.
The longsword swing in cold moon-white.
Any weapon: a sickly green edge as it hunts for a life.
The longbow shot, sworn to the target.
The quarterstaff strike.
The mace strike; the rod's other forms are their own FX if you want them.
The scimitar cut, fast.
A structure that rolls, not a weapon that swings — nothing to play.
Any weapon: a cold silver glint on the swing.
A staff that floats a trinket above its tip; there is no moment at the table to play.
The quarterstaff strike; the birdcall is a burst of feathers at the staff.
The charm read as hearts at the target, not as a staff swing.
The staff casts fire — a jet from the staff's head.
A flower conjured at the staff's tip, in a burst of leaves.
The staff casts cold — a cone of frost from its head.
Healing light at the target the staff touches.
A rune of power at the staff before its spell.
The quarterstaff strike with a force impact on the hit.
A cloud of insects at the target.
The adder's head bites — a poison impact at the target.
The archmage's rune at the staff before its spell.
The staff lands and becomes a snake, in a puff of smoke.
Leaves swirl at the druid's staff.
A lightning strike at the target, thunder behind it.
The withering touch — a necrotic toll at the target.
Boiling oil spilled into the square below.
The longsword swing; the riposte is the same cut, taken as a reaction.
The longsword swing in Vecna's red — the sword of Kas.
Any of six swords: the blade drinks, so the swing runs violet.
Any of four swords: a clean, bright cut.
Any of six swords: an angry, burning swing.
Any of six swords: the ordinary cut — the wound that will not close is the outcome, not the swing.
A stone thrown by counterweight, in a high arc.
The trident thrust, in sea blue.
Once drawn it is a longsword, so it swings as one.
Any weapon: a vicious red tear on the hit.
The mace strike with a necrotic impact — the wand of the demon lord.
The trident thrust with a wash of water behind it.
A warning that cannot be surprised is a state, not a moment — nothing to play on a swing.
Any weapon: a small gold glint marks the enchantment on the swing.
